product_one_liner.value: Qubrid AI provides a unified GPU infrastructure and AI platform for developers, researchers and enterprises to build, deploy, manage and scale AI/ML workloads.

named_customers.notes: Supported by a homepage customer testimonial and a published case study.

employee_band.notes: Based on PitchBook's reported 16 employees as of January 29, 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The indexes show product guides, pricing, benchmarks and tutorials, rather than two engineer-authored posts explaining how Qubrid itself is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes Quickstart, AI Templates, GPU and integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers site lists a Full Stack AI Engineer role with an application option.

model_provider.value: LLaMA, Mistral, CodeLlama and Stable Diffusion
model_provider.notes: The FAQ names these among more than 30 supported open-source models.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims include deployment in SOC 2- and HIPAA-compliant data centers; this does not establish company-wide certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest disclosed completed round: Angel (individual), June 14, 2024; amount undisclosed. The listed $25 million seed round is marked upcoming and is excluded.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed completed round is from June 2024, before the window; the upcoming seed round is not counted as raised.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board lists GPU Kubernetes Cluster Engineer and Full Stack AI Engineer, with no qualifying SDR, BDR or account executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 17, 2026, Dify announced the Qubrid AI plugin, enabling multi-model access within Dify workflows through one API key.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete dated leadership roster or verifiable C-level/VP arrival or departure within the window was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A job posting specifies maintaining and updating CRM using 'HubSpot/Zoho'; this is a tooling signal, not independent confirmation that both are deployed.
